scope: Surviving browser native fields, command transport and menu ownership across shared-host loss

implementation.retained_connections: Supervisor owns mode-0600 listener and retains accepted server endpoints. Original sockets and SCM_CREDENTIALS survive host replacement; no browser reconnect syscall or RPC proxy is introduced.
implementation.restoration: Private inherited role 4 transfers client endpoints and verified eventfd/pidfd/callback capabilities. Authenticated PREPARED/EPOCH/READY completes restoration before browser requests resume. Dead original owners are skipped.
implementation.epoch: Callback serial floor is epoch << 32; response generation advertises it. Shared transport rejects older nonzero epochs after observing a newer one. Chromium UI command tasks also compare captured epoch. No edits or commands are replayed by the supervisor.
implementation.epoll: Explicitly remove watches before closing shared open-file descriptions; unique tokens prevent stale numeric-descriptor reuse within a pending event batch.
implementation.menus: Shell-selected authenticated direct models take precedence over the same process D-Bus export. Both use existing native NSMenu objects. Native show refusal is retried; the bridge contains no second menu/control implementation.
implementation.key_deferral: While inside a native menu validation/tracking callback, defer the original key packet until the native stack returns. At most one per client, 128 clients, one-second expiry before the two-second RPC fallback. Revalidate input ownership and focus when executing; expired keys do not mutate native text.
implementation.control_character: Real seat Ctrl+A carried unmodified ASCII 1 while DOM key was a. Control-only nonlogical events reuse the existing DOM key for GNUstep charactersIgnoringModifiers. No binding table or Emacs policy is copied.
implementation.appmenu_objects: Permit replacement object creation before old object release. Keep first surviving object, promote on release and retain cross-client ownership checks, matching protocol and KWin lifecycle.
implementation.shutdown: Private STOP drains native teardown before display/bus removal, followed by bounded TERM/KILL escalation if needed. Record original exception frames before role EOF so a supervisor reaction does not mask it.
implementation.install: Install connections.py with reused host/helper modules; include Activation.h in Wayland package source snapshot.

upstream_sources.finding: create and release define no unique-per-surface object error
create appends; appMenuForSurface returns the first matching object; release removes that object
